criterion_order: Apply specified search and filters on ClinicalTrials.gov
Sort results by Last Update Posted (newest first)
Report first displayed result (in displayed order) with required fields
Report second displayed result (in displayed order) with required fields
Report third displayed result (in displayed order) with required fields
Respect task constraints and stopping condition

criteria.criterion: Apply specified search and filters on ClinicalTrials.gov
criteria.final_justification: Give partial credit: the agent clearly attempted and (via URL) set the required condition and two facets (Recruiting + Phase 3) and also attempted United States location. But the DOM shows the displayed results include non-US locations, so we cannot award full credit that the Study Location filter is actually applied to the returned result set as required. No uncontrollable blocker is confirmed preventing correct filtering; this appears to be a mismatch/inconsistency rather than a site-down/CAPTCHA blocker.

criteria.criterion: Sort results by Last Update Posted (newest first)
criteria.final_justification: Award partial credit: there is explicit DOM support in the URL that sorting was set to lastUpdatePostDateDesc, but the requirement is that newest-first sorting be visibly applied; the DOM does not show the selected radio/label at the time of extraction. No confirmed blocker; just missing visible confirmation.

criteria.criterion: Report first displayed result (in displayed order) with required fields
criteria.final_justification: No credit: the agent did not deliver the first result with required fields in its final answer. While the DOM contains some study details, they were never reported. This is not an uncontrollable blocker preventing output (even though a snapshot timeout occurred at the end, the agent output still lacks the required data).

criteria.criterion: Report second displayed result (in displayed order) with required fields
criteria.final_justification: No credit: the agent did not report any second result. Even if we considered DOM state 12, it lacks the required Last Update Posted field and is not shown under the fully verified filter/sort state. No uncontrollable blocker is confirmed that would justify full credit.

criteria.criterion: Report third displayed result (in displayed order) with required fields
criteria.final_justification: No credit: the agent did not report a third result with required fields. Available DOM snippets also do not provide Last Update Posted for a third card, so even partial extraction isn’t evidenced as delivered.

criteria.criterion: Respect task constraints and stopping condition
criteria.final_justification: Partial credit: constraints appear respected (no prohibited actions), but the agent did not satisfy the stopping condition and did not produce the required report; continued extraneous navigation until timeout.
